text: This thing is awesome literally exactly what I wanted below the price I wanted to pay zero problems with it

The first unit initially was DOA out of the box, Amazon replaced it with a new unit. The second unit failed just after the return period expired; it no longer communicates with the AcuRite server. I tried disconnecting and reconnecting the unit from both power and network without any change. Hit the "reset" button, which extinguished all indicator lights (except on the network connector). I'll try contacting the company, but cannot recommend the product.
UPDATE 3/15/17
I contacted AcuRIte. After a brief hold, I was assisted by a knowledgeable technician who spoke English! He guided me through a reset that was different from that listed in the owners' manual, and the device was up and running. 5 stars for their tech support! Only 4 stars for the devices (one DOA, one failed and resurrected). All in all, would recommend the product.
These work great! Very easy to setup and I can monitor my home from anywhere giving me peace of mind. I have these in a home in Vermont but I live full time in NY. Very reliable and accurate.
Excellent system!
Other than one of the sensors not working, it worked great and the website worked great, and was easy to setup.
Worked very well until my smart hub stopped working after 6 months. I was very pleased with the product. I hope there is an avenue to work with Acurite to get this replaced.

I would give this zero stars if possible.  The smart hub broke after some update, about 4 months in.  Customer service is non-existent.  The only way I got in touch with anybody was through a message board.  The company sent me a new hub, but that didn't work either.  I have spent hours troubleshooting this stupid thing to no avail.  There are lots of people on the message boards with the exact same complaints.  Save your money.
Temperature is not accurate.  Takes 10 minutes to get updates.
Good items

Every once in a while, I have a connection issue with these; I'm not sure if its the internet or the product itself.

Otherwise, it works great.

The emailed warnings are great, as well as the phone app that allows you to track the each monitor's temperature.
Havent had to use these yet but is the right fit for the french press I gave as a gift. Fast shipping, no problems, pleasant people, would order again.
Awesome. Great replacement for an old filter. Fits perfectly.
I wish I would have noticed that there isn't a ring around the center hole. The screen is also flimsier than the ones I'm accustomed to. Get what you pay for.
These fit nicely our SterlingPro French Press, but will fit others as well. Thrilled to have no grinds or film only a great tasting cup of coffee. Good product as advertised.

These are nicely made filters. Symmetric and fit well. I prefer those with the metal ring in the center. Using these ones as a second filter in my coffee press cut the amount of coffee grounds to very low amounts!
These work fine on my press as a second filter. Be aware that these do not have the little stainless-steel reinforcing ring in the center. Price is great!
works great!
Fits Bodum Chambord 4 Cup French Press and Bodum Brazil 8 Cup French Press fine and works well.
Does NOT fit an 8 cup BODUM.  TOO big for our 6 cup generic presses.  Not sure what it fits, but we have THREE different presses and it does NOT fit any of them .
Not as a high a quality as the original, but does the job.
These filter screens do a better job than the single screen the press came with,

I recently got a Bodum French press coffee maker. Even with coarse ground beans, I was getting more bean dust / micro debris through the single filter screen than I liked. Adding a second screen noticeably improved the filtering. These are good, but lack the center reinforcement of the original and the rolled edge is not quite as smoothly finished. However, getting 6 of these for the same price as 2 of the original type replacements led me to go with these.

These replacement filters were better made and performed better than the screen which came with the press.
I highly recommend these filters, 3 for $10 is not a bad deal either.
What's to say?  They're filters.  And they work.
Great quantity for affordable price
These screens seem lighter than the original Bodum screen, but seem to do a good job.
You may have to cut and size to fit but otherwise a perfect replacement for my coffee filter!

Arrived in an envelope and all 3 filters were bent. I bent them back as best as I could. Still getting a few grounds in my coffee after plunging, but not as bad as it was. A bit disappointed this single they were shipped
Said they would fit my coffee press but are a little smaller than original screen so does not filter properly.
Better quality screens than I expected for the price. Clean edges, and the screens remain their shape after extended use.
Not as good as the original one  nut they work good if u double them up.
Worked as needed, but nothing really special. Nor should it be.
Great filters at a good price
just what I need for the french press

these are a perfect fit to my 4cup press though a little smaller than the original and not as sturdy, but they do work just fine and are good enough to last for a long time plus you get three so it is worth the cost, especially when you do not want to pay the cost of a new press for a single or double replacement screen
I'd ordered the wrong size initially.  The company was most helpful in getting me the size I needed.  The filters work just how I'd hoped.
Best value on these filters, by far.
Doesn't work in my 32 oz French press.  These are poorly made knock offs.  Do yourself a favor don't buy them
Worked great with both a Bodum and Ikea french press.

Mine measured 3 5/8" round and fits my 34 oz  french press perfectly. Also, these filters are a great buy. I've been using mine for over a month with no noticeable wear. My original screen filter had the metal ring in the center and I thought these replacement ones would not be as good. Well they are perfect.
These are very nice !!  So glad I decided to purchase them . I believe that anyone that orders these will be very satisfied with the quality and performance .
Great product at a great price. No complaints
True these are not the most high end but you are not paying high end prices.  For what they are they work well enough in a pinch and you can always double them up.  Good to have as spares on hand.

These seem cheap but they are really good! I had to get filters without the solid centered ring around the hole because they wouldn't work with my French press. They were too big, not allowing me to tighten the plunger on to them. These ones fit well and work well and are cheaper than the others too. I would buy them again.
Great price, fast delivery, excellent product. Couldn't be better!
A good deal and a we see a repeat purchase in the future :)

I really like the filters, they are super fine. I now use two filters in my French press, but I still find the fine grain in the bottom of my cup. It's not the filters, it's probably the grind I'm using.
Filters work great and fits perfectly.

These filters fit perfectly-- I couldn't have asked for anything better. I had bought an insulated french press from another source and liked it except that the filter was quite coarse, producing excellent-tasting but very sludgy coffee. After a long search for fine screen material, I ran across these pre-formed replacement filters and took a chance that I could make something work for my press. Imagine my surprise and great elation when I found these to be perfectly-formed and of precisely the proper dimensions!!! Thank you, Procizion!

And now, I intend to search out YOUR french press, as I need another for a gift!

I bought these to use for frothing milk and they work well but because they don't have a center metal piece I am not sure how well they will hold up. At least the price is right and with 6 to a package it should work out well.
Just as described. Two filters together trap all the grounds. Wonderful!
it does the job
just what I was looking for.  Cannot comment on longevity yet but do not see any reason these filters should not get the same or better life than the original.
Perfect replacement filter for my Boudin French press.

Great deal, works perfectly in my Thermos stainless steel French press.
No center grommet if that matters to you. Doesn't affect operation at all.

I'm no coffee connoisseur, but WOW, what a big difference by just replacing my slightly rusty and somewhat frayed 5 year old screen with a new one. Who knew coffee could be so ungritty and so iron deficient?
The filters work perfectly in my small french press.
These were perfect for my French press. I was impressed with this deal since I paid about the same as I saw others selling 2 and 4 packs.

The item is not as pictured/described. The photo shows filters meant for my press (Secura). It has no metal grommet in the center of the filter disk. The filters (6) that were sent have the metal grommet and the hole is larger than what my press needs, so grounds can slip through.
Love the ability to get more filters for my coffee press. These work great
item as advertised would recommend
I bought these to use with my Kuissential 8-Cup Stainless Steel French Press.  They fit perfect!  They were packaged nicely.  The price was great and I'm set for a while now.  Very happy with these.
A little bit smaller than expected, but still works ok.
Good value and works well with 17oz steel Frieling French Press
Excellent product.  Great price.  Company Followed up after purchase to assure satisfaction - impressive customer service.  I recommend this company.
Great product for the price, would get it again

Really high quality screens. They do not seem to wear on the edges the way the original ones that came with my french press did. I'm not sure if we were shipped the wrong product or not, but the center of my screens has an extra band of metal that make them incredibly sturdy, but is not shown in the produce pictures. (See my included picture with this review.) Have used them almost every day for a month and am still really pleased with them.
Undersized!  Had to buy something else.  These are about 1/4" too small all the way around our French Press plunger.  Very disappointing and a waste of money.  Not as described.  Look elsewhere.
Fits perfectly.
Fit perfectly with my Sterling Pro coffee press. I had some issues earlier with another filter, but this one fit perfectly.
Well packaged. Arrived as promised. Fit perfect. We will order again when needed. Good to know replacements are available for our french press..thank you.
No complaints
Amazing, works a lot better then the screen that came with my french press.
Glorious!
I used them to filter my coffee and they work great, so far I only have one on with the original French press filter and it works great.
They are decent filters! I've had some issues with the metal coming undone and poking my fingers (ouch), other than that, they are a good quality!

Needed a replacement screen for my french press.  Used the old one for a couple of years until it finally started to unravel on the sides.  Looked around and found this universal pack of three.  First, they fit just fine.  Second, they are definitely a made from a much thinner grade gauge of mesh so I figure they will not last as long.  Also, they do not have the reinforced grommet in the center hole so perhaps the center will begin to wear sooner. So the only reason I do not give it five stars is for durability which I will not know until I use these screens.  The first one has worked just fine for the past couple of months I have used it.  However, whether they hold up as long as the original may not be much of a factor considering you get 3 of them for only $10.99.  So I figure durability will not be such a big deal.
They were great.  they fit  and that's what matters. Thank you
Filters seem to fit and filter just fine.
Great item to have I love eating ice.
It works fast and is doing great.  Fits under our 5thwheel in storage because of its smaller size.

love this until it started telling me that it needed water and darn thing was full of water.  had to leave it un-plugged for 24 hours so it could reset itself.  when I spend this kind of money I expect that the item is going to work without issues for longer then 1 month.  I will think twice before I by another item from Della corporation and this seller
I had to send back because it was defective. but I have another that works just fine
Works great
Works great.  But only makes 9ice cubes at a time and they seem to melt pretty fast.
The ice maker worked just fine.. Made batches of ice in less than 10 minutes.. The bin filled in a little over a hour and the device stopped until ice was used or the ice melts down.
love how quick the machine makes the ice.  got a lot when needed for a gathering of 10.  only thing was when you put the ice in a bin it's still wet so sticks together when put back in the freezer.
Works like a champ
It works perfectly, making the ice just as I wanted.  I recommend this product without reservation.

Since we are in a rental home we didn't get to choose our refrigerator and ended up with one that doesn't have an ice maker. After months of buying bags of ice and having it take up valuable freezer space we decided to get one of these after talking to a friend that has one. It is absolutely worth the money spent to have my freezer space cleared up and to be able to make as much or as little ice as we need! No more frantic trips to the gas station when we have company over and are low on ice. The ice cubes are a nice size and there is no worry of spilling the tray of water on the way to the freezer with the typical ice cube trays. I love that we can take it camping and also to anywhere else we move to. Good quality and exactly as described, I didn't have any of the problems that other reviewers have had. Would highly recommend for anyone that rents, camps or has a fridge that doesn't make ice.
Product does what it claims.Super easy to follow user directions.The machine is quite and makes excellent ice.

We never seem to have enough ice in our house with the three kids and all their sports. I decided to get this ice maker as a gift to my husband for Father's Day because he is alway frustrated when he goes to get ice from the freezer and it is all gone. We have had the ice maker for about a month now..... we just love it! It makes ice so quickly and we have yet to run out. The only reason I didn't give it the full 5 stars is for a couple kinda picky self reasons. The ice scoop when put in the ice storage tray takes up space not allowing as much ice to fill the tray and the machine detects it is full and stops making ice. I don't like to put the ice scoop in because my children open it up and put there hands in the ice to get it out. Kids will be kids and their hands aren't always as clean as they could be. That being said a ice scoop holder on the side of the machine or in the lid would be an excellent up grade. The other reason would be when the ice falls into the storage tray it does fall all the way to the front and the machine stops making ice thinking it is full. When you open it up and even the ice out it then starts making ice again realizing it wasn't full. Other then those two minor and kinda picky issues, this is a must have in a house where ice is always running low or out. I definitely recommend this to anyone looking for a counter top ice maker.
Fairly quite, makes ice quickly, small foot print for counter use
These are a tad pricey, but works great so far.
Makes great ice as long as you need.
works great and as stated!

My family and I love this little machine.  We love to have ice in all of our drinks and this product is quick in making ice. It is also very compact and doesn't take too much counter space, perfect for our apartment. Easy to set up and easy to maintain. It is also very quiet.
Great, so far. I make ice almost every day in it.

makes the ice quick but it is smalll amounts.  its good for ongoing ice consumption.  would be better if you didn't have to keep transferring ice to a freezer after it was made.  they should have made the bin refrigerated too.
Stopped working after 4 months. Company would not respond to my emails.
It came on time and I am great full with my Ice Maker,it works very smoothly and Love It, now I don't need to spend my money buying anymore Ice, Thank You so Kindly.

Thought id try one of these countertop ice makers. I usually buy a bag from the local grocery store once a week. Follow the instructions and let it sit for an hour before plugging unit into outlet. Saw a post from a repairman that pretty much said the same thang. He said an hour or two. It works as advertised so far on first use. Update this thing is finakey the add water light comes on even though there's plenty of water in the tank. It doesn't seam to like making small ice bullets.
I really love this machine.
Very munchable ice. Quiet. Man, my drinks are cold now.

I bought this for my cabin that runs on a small, portable solar power solution for the time being. I've been using it for the last few days here at my regular home and this thing is just fantastic so far!

Being able to have ice on demand while I am camping out at the cabin and working on finishing the inside of the cabin is perfect for me. Where I run on a portable solar solution out there, the fact that this runs peak at 230 watts @115 volts (2 amps) works out really well for that. Once I take this one up to the cabin, I may end up buying a second one for here at the regular home front. It is that convenient to have.

Love it we live in an RV and were buying ice constantly. We use it a lot each day, as long as I dump the tray each time it is full into the freezer bucket it keeps up with the two of us. Haven't had to buy ice since. Works great.

Delivers on every promise. About 7 minutes from start to ice. We live in a yurt with a very tiny freezer - but love ice in the summer. This has resolved our problem perfectly and is small too.

The only thing not perfect is the bright LED status light that says you have power. It blinks on and off all night long and is annoying without a way to turn it off (without unplugging).

Black tape has solved that too - but is it really necessary to let you know your device is plugged in?

Great little ice maker!. You do have to pay attention to it when it needs water and when it senses that it is full . It does make ice at the rate that is claimed. I don't have to go out and buy ice anymore. I am very pleased.
I bought it for our camper, it was a nice fit. It almost paid for itself on it first camping trip. Not having to run to buy ice.

Ice maker works great. I couldn't believe it when it made the frist batch in 6 minutes. I have only had this for 1 week and I hope it keeps working like it is now. The only thing is for the last week I have had 3 or 4 emails asking me to give a review on this product this isn't cool not at all. I started not to give this review just for this.reason again not cool.
This little ice maker is the best!  It's half the size of the one it replaced and puts out twice the amount of ice and in half the time.  I'm very impressed.  It's very worth the price!!!

I purchased this for my office. The water quality is terrible in our building. This is a perfect solution! Makes ice super fast and it's very easy to clean.

***UPDATE:
I had to take away 2 stars. After 1 year of ownership, I believe the pump or motor is burning out. The machine makes a terrible sound when trying to get water from the reservoir. Will probably have to purchase a new one. And I would not go with the same brand. Not if I have to replace it every year.

When my ice maker broke in my fridge, I purchased this and it is amazing.  It makes ice fast and I just scoop it out and put it in my freezer's automatic ice dispenser, which works great. Of course after a while, the one in my fridge started working again on it's own, but I love thing, that I just keep using it anyway.
Works well.  Make a good amount of ice.  It's very noisy while making ice so consider that.  I use it in my home theater.
It is a excellent ice maker, love it.
Bought this for staff at the school I work.  Everyone loves the ice and it is running daily.  Nearly keeps up with all our ice needs.
I love it !!!!!!

I LOVE IT!!! I make ice every day with it... I load it and start it in the morning and it makes a big bowl of ice that keeps in my reefer all day and night for personal use... Highly recommended for those that like ice in everything...
works fast and no problems

Got a smokin' deal on this. Read other reviews and it seemed comparable to units costing substantially more. It got here sooner than expected and has been steadily kicking out ice since we first fired it up. We allowed it to sit for an hour before turning it on, based on other reviewers' suggestions.
The unit is much quieter than I expected. Almost no fan noise. Occasional motor noises as it reloads to drop ice. Then, of course, we hear the ice fall. I can honestly say that we have never had the problem of too much ice before. With a dying ice maker in the old refrigerator spitting out a few pieces with the regularity of a passing comet, we needed this.
Very satisfied with it.

Update 5-14-2018: We ended up getting about 13 months out of it before it quit working. First, it wouldn't stop making ice, then it wouldn't make any. Looks like the sensor up top went out. No response from the company about parts or solutions. It was good while it lasted. Kinda irritated now.

A little bit noisy but that doesn't bother me.  Ice is very wet and sticks together when I transfer to the freezer.  I keep it in a heavy duty baggie and just break it loose on the counter when taking it out of the freezer.
works fast, but delivers very small pieces which seam to melt quickly. whole bin is not even to one normal tray from freezer.
Seams to work great
Easy to Use & Clean.

It took about a week of running filtered water through it before the chemical taste ceased, but now, it's practically perfect. The only thing it would need to become perfect is to make less noise when it's making the ice.
Works nice and fast, only have used it on one trip so far, its nice knowing you can make ice as needed while camping.

I really like the icemaker!  The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is because after using it a few times it's making a little humming noise sometimes.  But that is not affecting the operation of the product at all.
Plugged it in. Started working perfectly. I've used it for only two days, so far very happy with purchase.
This product is very easy to use, & care for.

If I could give this product 0 stars, I would. It just quit ! I called the cust. ser. # and was told there was only. 90 day warranty. Tough luck! A disposable item with no customer service ! Wow! No one cares.

I've had this machine for a few months now. First and foremost, the ice this machine makes stinks. It smells like plastic or some manufacturing odor. I thought the smell would dissipate with time, but it hasn't. We cannot use this ice for drinking, because it makes our drinks smell bad. Luckily, I purchased to primarily make ice for ice compresses to treat migraines. For that it works well, as I cannot smell the ice when it is sealed in my ice bag. I've created ice with the same water using this machine and ice cube trays. Only the ice from this machine smells. I cleaned the ice maker as indicated in the start-up instructions, but perhaps it needs a more thorough cleaning. It doesn't really lend itself to that, however I may try to clean it more thoroughly. I will update my review if anything changes.

It makes ice fast, but wait. First cubes come out in about 6 minutes (wow), but you only get about enough cubes for 1 glass (barely). The cubes are small. However, although the larger size cubes don't look that much bigger, they are thicker so melt considerably slower. We keep it on the large ice setting.

Ice created is often wet. After watching the machine, it seems that overflow water from filling the ice "tray" may flow over the previously created ice en route to the water reservoir below. Also any water that has pooled below the ice tray may be scooped into the ice basket with the next cubes. Not sure why that was a good design choice, but that

Updating - I bought a Della last year (March 2016) So we've not quite had it a year. We hit a series of problems listed in the order below and btw I've noticed other people complain of similar things happening

1) the add water light comes on when there is a full reservoir - this is likely caused by lint or something stopping up the tubing. Also there is a little motor that brings the water up from the reservoir to the icemaker, we had a tiny hair wrapped around the gear.

Also 2) it will overheat - solution is to brush the dust off the compressor coils.

3) it got out of sync - and keeps going backward and forward never actually stopping to make ice - in ours there are 2 switchs that must be "hit" to cycle through the ice making process. Those switches each have a spring inside and we guess the spring is either broken or came off, at this point it is likely not worth fixing.

We've gone through all of this with our Della, as I said we are now at problem #3. My husband is a whiz at fixing things so we literally wear things out before replacing. I would love to be able to fix it but we do not know who to call to order parts - this is where warranties come in. Wish we'd had one. I am now researching ice makers to replace the Della
Makes ice consistently. Is easy to use. Very convenient. Had no problems setting it up!

Works really well.  Bought it to use for ski patrol at our small local slope.  Most injuries we see use ice and the chemical packs aren't great.  This machine is pretty fast and effective - I bought it 2 months ago and we do turn it off at night although it can stay on.  The ice is hollow in the middle and doesn't last as long as a solid cube but the benefits far outweigh that downside or any other alternative.
I have only had this icemaker since 03/01/2017. I have only used it 3 times and it will not come on. It is now March 9th
Works very well. Would recommend if you're looking at not buying bags of ice from the store any more.
makes ice but deosnt keep ice so be ready to use it be4 ypu turn it on...
Makes a lot of ice fast. Can't wait to use this camping!!

Got this unit for service in my craft beer & wine bottle shop. It seems to work well but is slow. It also randomly stops with the message 'ice full' when there is no ice in the basket. The only way I can get it to proceed, is to power the unit off, and on. Probably a sensor issue. It's quiet, but given the issues already with the sensor (it's only a week old), I'm not sure how long it will last.

I ordered this to go in the bar at the office and it's perfect.  It doesn't take up much space, is fairly quiet (you'll hear the fan running and the ice when it dumps into the holding basket), is pretty good looking for an appliance, and does just what you want it to.  It makes ice, almost surprisingly quickly.  Like all the other portables I've seen, it doesn't really refrigerate, though, so you'll want to use the ice as it comes out.  The whole unit looks well insulated, but this isn't a "freezer" so to speak.  You wouldn't just leave ice in the basket and expect it to be there the next day.

Thankful to have this gem of an appliance. I drink distilled water and wanted distilled ice cubes. This icemaker does not disappoint. Ice is produced quickly and relatively inconspicuously. No more buying bags of ice!

UPDATE!!!
This ice maker worked fine for a few months and suddenly the 'Add Water' light would come on when the machine was at capacity for water. Would love a remedy for this problem.
ok

Item arrived looking used or something. Found black little rock like in shape contaminates inside the unit-ROACH POOP if you ask me. Also found white spots through out the inside of the item, looked NASTY. Item also has a Big Scratch on the top of it.

I'm pretty sure that the small and large cubes are the exact same size. The picture made it look like cubes were pretty small. They are not.  They are only slightly smaller than you would get from an ice cube tray. Other than that, it works fine and makes ice quickly.
I love the ice, however the machine says to add water and ice full when it is not.

Works great once I figured how to put the basket back in the thingie 😁

Update- after 5 months it died. I called onebigoutlet and they said they cannot help me. If you buy this amazing ice maker check more buying options and buy from Amazon vendor. At least they CAN help if something goes wrong. Worth the extra 6 bucks.
Better than expected. Washed it out, filled it with water and in 15 minutes had ice, fantastic.
works great.. love the ice

Liked it very much in the beginning.  However it quit working at 8 months due to the electric eye rusting over. I was able to clean it twice but now at one year I can't get it to work any more.  It still think the tray is full. Unfortunatey I did not purchase the two year warranty.
love it!!
